items.followUp: What is meant by a balanced diet?

rubric.why: Identifies a vitamin that acts as a co-enzyme.
rubric.description: Names at least one co-enzyme vitamin.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming a correct vitamin, such as B1, B2 or B3.

rubric.description: Names at least two co-enzyme vitamins.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming at least two correct examples.

modelAnswer: Important vitamins that act as co-enzymes include vitamin B1 (thiamine), vitamin B2 (riboflavin) and vitamin B3 (niacin).

rubric.why: States that nutrition involves obtaining food.
rubric.description: Defines nutrition as involving the obtaining or intake of food.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the food-obtaining part of the definition.

rubric.why: States that nutrition also involves using the food obtained.
rubric.description: Includes the utilization or use of food.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the food-utilization part of the definition.

modelAnswer: Nutrition is the process by which organisms obtain and utilize food.
